完整读取 current facts，但只记录来源直接断言的 kinship、residence 和 birth。每个 relationship 必须选择 facts 中实际出现的 relation_cue，并使 relation_type、source_basis 与该 cue 联合一致；source_term 内还必须明确支持 related_person 相对于 reference_person 的方向。婚姻、dependency、付款本身、问题文本及人物共同出现不能建立父母、子女、兄弟姐妹、住所或出生。residence 必须含来源中的 residence_cue、人物、连接词和独立 location；不得把 residence_cue 当作地点，也不得从婚姻推断共同住所。日期文本必须由同一 facts witness 支持；只陈述起点时 end_date/end_text 保持 null。已读且没有事实时返回空数组，未读时返回 null。
Shared native event meanings: Shared factual encoding from the author statute program:
service_(event), agent_(service,worker), patient_(service,employer).
payment_(event), agent_(payment,payer), patient_(payment,payee),
purpose_(payment,service_event), amount_(payment,amount).
purpose_(service,"domestic service"|"agricultural labor") is a stated service kind.
marriage_(event) has an agent_ fact for EACH spouse.
death_(event) has agent_(event,deceased), start_(event,actual_death_date).
enrollment_(event) has agent_(event,student), patient_(event,institution).
attending_classes_(event) has agent_(event,student), location_(event,institution).
educational_institution_(event) has agent_(event,institution).
income_(event) has agent_(event,recipient), amount_(event,amount).
start_/end_ describe the dates/period of that SAME event, not arbitrary dates
belonging to a different event. A stated annual income can be represented over
its stated calendar year with canonical year bounds; this does not invent the
date of an instantaneous payment. Never allocate a cross-year payment or give
it a payment date copied from a service period without support.

Explicit source-stated intermediate legal givens, with ordered arguments:
s151_b_applies(taxpayer:string,spouse:string,year:integer)
s151_c_applies(taxpayer:string,dependent:string,year:integer)
s63_f_1_A(taxpayer:string,year:integer)
s63_f_1_B(taxpayer:string,spouse:string,year:integer)
s151_b(taxpayer:string,exemption_amount:number,year:integer)
s152_c_1(dependent:string,taxpayer:string,year:integer)
Keep source polarity and taxpayer/beneficiary direction. A151(d) statement is not automatically a151(b)/(c) fact. Never assert the target predicate or infer unstated ages, deaths or relationships. This is shared infrastructure, not learned legal knowledge.

{"task": {"current_case": {"facts": "In 2017, Alice was paid $33200. Alice and Bob have been married since Feb 3rd, 2017. Bob earned $10 in 2017. Alice and Bob file separate returns. Alice is not entitled to a deduction for Bob under section 151.", "question": "Section 63(c)(5) applies to Bob's basic standard deduction in 2017.\nNative query constraints from this same original TRAIN task (truth value not supplied): s63_c_5(\"Bob\",_,_,2017,500)."}, "current_legal_query": {"native_query": [{"arguments": ["Bob", {"variable": "_"}, {"variable": "_"}, 2017, 500], "predicate": "s63_c_5"}], "query_clause": "s63_c_5"}, "component_meanings": {"family_relationship_residence": "从 current facts 提取有明确来源 cue 和有向角色结构的亲属关系、带独立地点的明确住所及实际出生；婚姻、共同出现或仅有逐字引文均不建立这些事实。"}}, "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"family_relationship_residence": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["views"], "properties": {"views": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["extraction_status", "relationships", "residences", "births", "witnesses"], "properties": {"extraction_status": {"type": "string", "enum": ["complete", "unread"]}, "relationships": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": false, "maxItems": 0}, "residences": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": false, "maxItems": 0}, "births": {"type": ["array", "null"], "items": false, "maxItems": 0}, "witnesses": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "required": ["field", "quote"], "properties": {"field": {"const": "facts"}, "quote": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}}}}}, "allOf": [{"if": {"properties": {"extraction_status": {"const": "complete"}}}, "then": {"properties": {"relationships": {"type": "array"}, "residences": {"type": "array"}, "births": {"type": "array"}}}}]}}}}}, "required": ["family_relationship_residence"], "additionalProperties": false}}
